Name: Harvey Revised (CP)
Author: stanloona420
Description:
I don't have much to say for Harvey since I didn't change too much of him, just enough to make him super cute lol. I like it!

I don't think I changed him drastically enough to warrant editing his character sheet so I didn't -- this mod replaces [b]portraits only.[/b]
You can leave vanilla's character sheets in place, or maybe pair him with another mod such as Crysanthe's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/879]Harvey Refined[/url]. Up to you!


** the UI mod seen in my ingame pictures is part of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]!

Downloads.Description: Finally, after one billion years, a version that should have a functioning manifest file. It was just missing one closing brace! Sorry about that.
